primary_question: What is the most credible true-positive (or high-priority unknown) threat visible right now, and what multi-source evidence supports that conclusion?

steps.title: Triage open cases under noise
steps.learner_objective: Rank open incidents and justify why {{CASE_PRIMARY}} is worth opening even when the queue is full of Large Upload noise.

suggested_actions.template: Scored table of recent new cases
Rank open incidents; choose primary case

hints_learner_safe: Highest score is not always a true positive — note the name and category.
Large Upload and ZGrab rows are common venue noise; still pick a case you can multi-source.

steps.title: Open the Host Sweep case
steps.learner_objective: Extract local host, remote endpoints, category, and interface path from the case — before deciding malice.

suggested_actions.template: Pull incident + extra + findings + first host identify

hints_learner_safe: Write down action_local_ip and action_remote_ip:port for each alert.
Zone Protection 'Host Sweep' toward public DNS is a known false-positive shape.

steps.title: Identify the host (and accept agentless limits)
steps.learner_objective: Build a network-only identity for {{HOST_A}}: type, MAC/user, hostname, BH map miss, confidence.

suggested_actions.template: Venue map lookup (expect empty off training ranges)

hints_learner_safe: No Cortex agent does not mean 'unknown evil' — it means network telemetry only.
Hostname only {{HOSTNAME_A}} and privacy MAC are normal for Apple private Wi-Fi.

steps.title: Corroborate with DNS, outbound, and threats
steps.learner_objective: Use XQL recipes to show SaaS/MDM profile and informational-only threats — not C2.

suggested_actions.template: Show public resolver is widely used (not unique IoC)

hints_learner_safe: Look for MDM (Kandji), Slack workspaces, Apple services — staff/attendee shape.
Informational TLS ECH / post-quantum cipher alerts are not malware.

steps.title: Disposition: false positive with disproof
steps.learner_objective: Write a defensible FP disposition: what was ruled out, confidence, and what a human should do next (no auto-isolate).

suggested_actions.template: MUTATION — only with human confirmation (optional in live ops)

hints_learner_safe: A good FP close cites at least two independent evidence classes.
Recommend resolve; do not isolate an agentless host on this evidence.
